title: Trade-In Agreements: Title Documents and Title-Delay Periods
content:
Four documents complete the title requirement on a vehicle traded under **Trade-In Agreements**; how long Kestrel waits for a lienholder's release and the title-delay chargeback figures are set per condition grade.

| Term | Inoperable | Rough | Fair | Good | Very Good | Excellent |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Wait for the lienholder's release after the payoff is sent, before the customer is asked for a lien release letter (calendar days) | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Title-delay chargeback period (calendar days after pickup) | 45 | 45 | 45 | 45 | 45 | 45 |
| Title-delay chargeback percentage of the credited trade value | 100 | 100 | 100 | 100 | 100 | 100 |
| Title documents that complete the title requirement | Paper title, electronic lien release, lien release letter, duplicate title | same four | same four | same four | same four | same four |

## Accepted title documents

| Document | Completes the title requirement |
|---|---|
| Paper title | Yes |
| Electronic lien release | Yes |
| Lien release letter | Yes |
| Duplicate title | Yes |

Only these four documents complete the title requirement at any grade.

## Notes

- The 30-day wait runs from the day the payoff is sent.
- The chargeback period is 45 calendar days after pickup at every grade, and the grade's title delay chargeback percentage is 100 percent at every grade.
